description: Appliance catalogue of Assignment 2, in the format of Assignment 1. Flexible loads FL_L1 ... FL_L4: the Assignment 1 load structure (reference hourly profile, a maximum hourly deviation of 1 kWh from it within the bounds 0-3 kWh/h, minimum daily energy equal to the daily reference energy) with a LINEAR disutility c^L x |l_t - l_ref_t| of 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0 DKK/kWh (from the most to the least flexible). PV_01_S (3 kW) is the PV system of every PV owner; BAT_01_S (2 kWh, 0.75 kW) the battery of every battery owner.

loads.hourly_bounds_rule: in every hour the load lies within max_hourly_deviation_kWh of the reference load, and within [min_load_KWh_per_hour, max_load_KWh_per_hour]: l_t in [max(0, l_ref_t - D), min(L_max, l_ref_t + D)]
loads.min_total_energy_rule: equal to the daily reference energy: max_load_KWh_per_hour x sum_t reference_load_capacity_factor[t]; the value above is the one of day d1, and the loader (or scenario_generation.day_data) sets it from the reference profile of the day loaded
